top_signals.title: FedEx Freight sees volumes stabilize, eyes Q4 margin improvement
top_signals.summary:
FedEx Freight reported Thursday that volumes continue to stabilize, and it anticipates stronger operating leverage next year, bolstered by business wins and an improved freight mix from its dedicated sales teams.
